backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing a courier booking system with access control, user profiles, parcel tracking, status updates, and admin functions for managing shipments with various shipping options.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no features documented.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend components, pages, hooks, and styles for the ML Enterprise courier service application.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the ML Enterprise Mokokchung Courier Service Integration application with root div and module script reference.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing authentication state, profile setup flow, conditional rendering of admin dashboard vs public homepage, and global UI elements like theme provider and WhatsApp button.
frontend/src/components/BookingConfirmat: Modal dialog displaying booking confirmation details with tracking number copy functionality and button to open shipping label printing interface.
frontend/src/components/BookingDetailsDi: Admin dialog showing complete booking information with status update form, tracking history timeline, and shipping label printing capability.
frontend/src/components/BookingSection.t: Comprehensive booking form component with sender/receiver details including 6-digit pincode validation, package information, shipping options, and confirmation dialog integration.
frontend/src/components/BookingsTable.ts: Displays a table of bookings with status badges, date formatting, and a details dialog. Handles loading states and empty states, with actions to view individual booking details.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Renders contact information cards including address, phone, email, and business hours. Includes a WhatsApp contact card with pre-filled message link.
frontend/src/components/CourierPartnersS: Displays a grid of courier partner logos (Delhivery, Blue Dart DHL, Everyday Express) with hover effects. Shows trusted logistics partners working with ML Enterprise.
frontend/src/components/DashboardStats.t: Shows dashboard statistics in a grid of cards displaying total bookings, queued, in transit, and delivered counts. Each card has an icon and color-coded styling.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with company info, logo, quick navigation links, and contact details. Includes attribution to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/GallerySection.t: Image gallery showcasing operations with lightbox dialog for full-size preview. Displays three gallery images with captions and hover effects.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header with logo, navigation menu, and authentication button. Includes responsive mobile menu and smooth scrolling to page sections.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero banner with background image, gradient overlay, and call-to-action buttons for booking and tracking. Features ML Enterprise branding and tagline.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog component for completing user profile setup with name, email, and phone fields. Uses form validation and mutation hook to save caller user profile data.
Displays three delivery service tiers (Standard, Express, Overnight) in a card grid layout with icons, descriptions, and feature lists.
frontend/src/components/ShippingLabel.ts: Renders a printable/downloadable shipping label with barcode, booking details, addresses, and estimated delivery date. Includes print and download functionality.
frontend/src/components/TrackingResult.t: Displays parcel tracking information including current status, booking details, and tracking history timeline with status-specific icons and colors.
Section component with a form to search parcels by tracking number and displays results using TrackingResult component.
frontend/src/components/WhatsAppButton.t: Fixed floating button in bottom-right corner that opens WhatsApp chat with pre-filled message to business phone number.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout functionality with AuthClient integration and identity state management.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for interacting with the backend actor, including user profile management, booking creation, parcel tracking, status updates, and admin role checking.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for theming (light and dark modes), including colors for UI components, charts, and sidebar elements.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page displaying booking statistics and filterable tables for all bookings by status (queued, in transit, delivered), with access control for admin users.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page component that composes HeroSection, ServicesSection, CourierPartnersSection, TrackingSection, and ContactSection components.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining custom theme extensions including color schemes using OKLCH color space, border radius variables, animations, and plugin integrations.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking completed features (removal of GallerySection and BookingSection from HomePage) and pending feature requests for adding a comprehensive booking form with submit functionality.
